title: Configuration loading & error-handling conventions

user_story.i_want: every service to load typed configuration from defaults, files and environment variables, and to share error-handling conventions
user_story.so_that: services behave consistently and fail fast with clear messages

description: Settings structs live in stratum-core, one per concern: `AwsSettings` (optional endpoint_url, region, force_path_style), `DatabaseSettings`, `FirehoseSettings`, and so on. Load them with the `config` crate in layers: `config/default.toml`, then `config/{env}.toml`, then env vars (`STRATUM__SECTION__KEY`). Conventions: library crates define error enums with thiserror; binaries use anyhow in main and add `.context(...)`. Secrets never appear in logs.

acceptance_criteria.then: it exits non-zero with a message naming the missing key
the env value overrides the file value (test)

acceptance_criteria.given: a library returns its thiserror error
acceptance_criteria.when: main propagates it with `?` and context
acceptance_criteria.then: the printed error shows the whole context chain
